name: assistant-ui
notes: MIT. Runtime components (thread, assistant-modal, attachment …) need an assistant-ui runtime (@assistant-ui/react + an adapter such as the Vercel AI SDK); elements-* items are props-driven and render without one.

Registry index has 175 items. Skipped: lib/hook/style/page/item types, internal elements helpers (surfaces, tokens, range, href, task, *-state, modal-size, model-selection, receipt-focus), the provider logo set and the vendored shadcn primitives (accordion, badge, select, tabs, direction).
